_comment: Config for running in Kubernetes or Docker. Copy to cellgate.config.json, fill it in, and load it as a Secret - never commit the filled-in copy. See deploy/k8s/README.md.
_bindAddress: The LAN address HomeKit is advertised on. Under hostNetwork this is the node's own IP; set it explicitly if the Home app cannot find the bridge, since the auto-pick can choose an interface your iPhone cannot reach. The pod is pinned to one node by nodeSelector, so a fixed value here is safe.
_storagePath: Must point at the mounted volume, or HomeKit pairing state is lost on every restart and every controller has to re-pair.
